d3265926-65d8-435e-aacd-0f34dd6eb560.constraint:
'Context "User" inv RepScorePositive: self.reputationScore >= 0 and self.reputationScore <=5'

'Context "User" inv NamesNotEmpty: self.displayName.size() > 0 and self.fullName.size() > 0 and self.email.size() > 0'

'Context "User" inv UniqueId: User.allInstances()->isUnique(id)'

'Context "User" inv UniqueEmail: User.allInstances()->isUnique(email)'

'Context "User" inv DescriptionLength:
  self.description.isDefined() implies
    self.description.size() <= 1000'

c3728e5a-1289-4ef8-8073-a7afe79ac296.constraint:
'Context "Item" inv UniqueId:
  Item.allInstances()->isUnique(id)'

'Context "Item" inv TextNotEmpty:
  self.title.size() > 0 and self.description.size() > 0'

'Context "Item" inv HasAtLeastOneCategory:
  self.categories->notEmpty()'

'Context "Item" inv HasAtLeastOnePhoto:
  self.photoUrls->notEmpty()'

'Context "Item" inv CategoryStringsNotEmpty:
  self.categories->forAll(c | c.size() > 0)'

'Context "Item" inv PhotoStringsNotEmpty:
  self.photoUrls->forAll(p | p.size() > 0)'

'Context "Item" inv UniqueCategories:
  self.categories->size() = self.categories->asSet()->size()'

23cc3729-340b-48e0-979b-a1d3a2076099.constraint:
'Context "ChatThread" inv UniqueId:
  ChatThread.allInstances()->isUnique(id)'

'Context "ChatThread" inv IdNotEmpty:
  self.id.size() > 0'

'Context "ChatThread" inv DistinctUsers:
  self.participants->size() = 2'

'Context "ChatThread" inv OwnerIsParticipant:
  self.participants->includes(self.item.owner)'

7e6bb28c-e252-47e0-a5c9-6ffae3612d5c.constraint:
'Context "Transaction" inv EndAfterStart:
  self.endTime > self.startAt'

'Context "Transaction" inv NoSelfTransaction:
  self.seller <> self.buyer'

'Context "Transaction" inv ConcludedLogic:
  (self.status = TransactionStatus::CONCLUDED implies self.concludedAt.isDefined()) and
  (self.status <> TransactionStatus::CONCLUDED implies not self.concludedAt.isDefined())'

'Context "Transaction" inv SellerMustBeOwner:
  self.item.owner = self.seller'

dd1f81fe-206d-4868-9660-a46ce2aa96bb.constraint:
'Context "Auction" inv PositiveMinBid:
  self.minBid > 0'

'Context "Auction" inv CurrentBidValid:
  self.currentBid.isDefined() implies self.currentBid >= self.minBid'

10ed71f6-4ccc-421c-9069-b48f5eae7439.constraint:
'Context "Bid" inv PositiveValue:
  self.value > 0'
'Context "Bid" inv ValueAtLeastMinBid:
  self.value >= self.auction.minBid'

'Context "Bid" inv BidWithinAuctionTime:
  self.placedAt >= self.auction.startAt and self.placedAt <= self.auction.endTime'

'Context "Bid" inv BidderNotSeller:
  self.from <> self.auction.seller'

fb81d878-71e1-406c-998c-c8995cf64e72.constraint:
'Context "Message" inv TextNotEmpty:
  self.text.size() > 0'

'Context "Message" inv SentAtNotEmpty:
  self.sentAt.size() > 0'

'Context "Message" inv SenderIsParticipant:
  self.chatThread.participants->includes(self.sender)'

3aecd3b8-b638-44df-9548-e0d78773e9df.constraint:
'Context "Review" inv ScoreRange:
  self.score >= 1 and self.score <= 5'

'Context "Review" inv CommentNotEmpty:
  self.comment.size() > 0'

'Context "Review" inv NoSelfReview:
  self.writtenBy <> self.writtenAbout'

'Context "Review" inv CreatedAtNotEmpty:
  self.createdAt.size() > 0'

e926b206-bb3d-4a71-a237-83f3cf270f72.constraint:
'Context "Community" inv UniqueId:
  Community.allInstances()->isUnique(id)'

'Context "Community" inv UniqueName:
  Community.allInstances()->isUnique(name)'

'Context "Community" inv RequiredFieldsNotEmpty:
  self.id.size() > 0 and self.name.size() > 0'

'Context Community inv DescriptionLength:
  self.description.isDefined() implies self.description.size() <= 2000'

cc909a59-7952-4dac-8a14-48170cf519ee.constraint:
'Context "Membership" inv BannedNotAdmin:
  self.status = Status::BANNED implies self.role <> Role::ADMIN'
